question: Does within-community b<2 / declining species CV with mean cover contain evidence for dominance stabilization beyond a null preserving species totals, annual community totals, and the observed occurrence mask?
motivation: A 2026 Ecography analysis interprets b<2 as a widespread potential dominance-stabilizing effect; classic feasible-set work shows Taylor-law form can arise from abundance and census constraints.

discovery.title: Temporal dynamics of marginal steppic vegetation over a 26-year period of substantial environmental change
discovery.measurement: percentage cover by species in three permanent 1 m2 plots
discovery.result: 2/3 plots passed under both null families

confirmation.title: LTER Norholm Hede, Denmark Plants
confirmation.measurement: species cover in five permanent plots; one recorded census per plot-year required, otherwise confirmation non-executable
confirmation.eligibility: Same as discovery: species present in >=15% census years with nonzero temporal variance; permanent plot must have >=4 eligible species; study must have >=5 eligible plots
confirmation.plot_rule: Within each eligible plot and null family: b lower-tail p<=.025 AND CVratio upper-tail p<=.025 using 999 nulls
confirmation.study_rule: For exponential and lognormal null families separately, observed plot-pass count must have upper-tail p<=.025 versus a study-level pseudo-observation pass-count distribution generated from the per-plot null draws. Additionally >=20% of eligible plots must pass the plot rule under BOTH families. All conditions required.
confirmation.null: Across the full observed species-by-year matrix, randomize positive cover magnitudes while preserving every species row total, every census-year column total, and the observed positive/zero support; metrics are then computed only for the frozen eligible-species subset. Primary weights iid Exponential(1) followed by IPF; sensitivity weights iid lognormal(0,1) followed by IPF.

replaced_source.reason: BioTIME metadata exposes Count abundance only and no Cover BIOMAS field; frozen cover-only confirmation cannot execute

second_replaced_source.reason: 40 quadrat-years contain two distinct Sep/Oct fall samples; frozen one-fall-census rule is ambiguous; no Taylor/CV statistic computed

confirmation.result: 0/5 plots passed; study-level p=1.0 under both families; confirmation failed

species_eligibility: present in >=15% of census years and nonzero temporal variance, matching the 2026 Ecography analysis
community_eligibility: >=4 eligible species, matching the 2026 Ecography analysis
primary_statistic: OLS slope b from log temporal variance versus log temporal mean cover across eligible species within each permanent plot
secondary_statistic: CVratio = arithmetic mean species CV / abundance-weighted mean species CV
null: Across the full observed species-by-year matrix, randomize positive cover magnitudes while preserving every species row total, every census-year column total, and the observed positive/zero support; metrics are then computed only for the frozen eligible-species subset. Primary weights iid Exponential(1) followed by IPF; sensitivity weights iid lognormal(0,1) followed by IPF.
decision_rule: A plot supports dominance stabilization beyond the constraint null only if observed b is below the 2.5th percentile of its null b distribution. Secondary CVratio must be above the 97.5th percentile for concordance; no claim if primary and secondary disagree.
multiplicity: Discovery is descriptive across the three study-713 plots; freeze a study-level confirmation prediction only if at least two of three discovery plots meet the primary rule with concordant secondary statistic. Confirmation will use a single predeclared aggregate criterion across eligible study-569 plots, defined before opening confirmation values.
holdout_note: Procedural holdout only; public BioTIME data are not a secure blind. Study 569 raw values will not be fetched during discovery.
measurement_negative_control: fridley_2009 pin-contact frequency rejected as primary before values because the 2026 paper excludes frequency/point-intercept methods for abnormal b<1; values not accessed.
null_sensitivity: Repeat the full discovery decision under lognormal(0,1) support weights; do not proceed to confirmation if primary and sensitivity disagree on whether >=2/3 plots pass.
stop_reason: Discovery extra-organization signal did not replicate in the frozen independent ecosystem. All confirmation slopes were <2 but ordinary under the constraint null; further null/source changes would be adaptive rescue.
